new_findings.title: Mobile QR fallback is plaintext FK:<code> which backend rejects by default
new_findings.detail: mobile/components/LoyaltyQR.jsx:51 — payload = qr ? qr.payload : 'FK:'+loyaltyCode; in standalone V1 qr is always null (no backend mint), so the mobile app renders plaintext FK:VICT1234. Backend scan path only accepts signed lqr.<payload>.<hmac> tokens since accept_legacy_plaintext flipped to FALSE (config/loyalty.php, GOAL-J2-HEAL-03). A customer presenting the mobile QR at borne/caisse scan will be REJECTED. Workaround exists and is proven: cashier manual entry of loyalty_code/phone (POS redeem live-proven). Fix at wireup = mobile calls POST /api/frontend/loyalty/qr (signed, throttle 30,1) — do NOT re-enable legacy plaintext (PII harvest vector).

new_findings.title: Mobile reward code LCY-XXXXXX 'a presenter a la caisse' has no backend counterpart
new_findings.detail: Redeem wizard step3 issues 'CODE A PRESENTER LCY-968546' (L-B7-mobile-redeem-step3.png) but no backend table/endpoint can validate or consume an LCY code — PosLoyaltyController takes loyalty_code/phone + points, not reward codes. Pure demo today; at publication this is a guaranteed counter-side UX dead-end (customer shows code, cashier has nowhere to enter it). Must be resolved before mobile publication (either kill the code UX or build redemption-voucher backend).
